notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 Notes
notes.notes:
Sound
- Some boss sound effects have been improved.
- New sound effects have been added.

*If crashes or freezing issues persist after the update, please report them on our Discord channel.
  Please find the link on the right side of the store page.

*Before reaching out, make sure your graphics drivers and BIOS are updated to the latest version!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Notes
notes.notes:
Sound
- Added jump sound effects based on terrain materials.
- Replaced sounds to better match the physical properties of objects.
- Added missing sounds such as balloon noises, footstep sounds for different terrain materials, and fire SFX.
- Adjusted sound balance.
- Updated BGM in some levels.

Player
- Alleviated the delay when reversing direction while running.
- Improved the flashlight's light effects to appear more natural.
- Enhanced the landing animation.

Level
- Improved visual expressions in some levels for more natural presentation.

Monster
- Enhanced monster appearance mechanics.

*If crashes or freezing issues persist after the update, please report them on our Discord channel.
  Please find the link on the right side of the store page.

*Before reaching out, make sure your graphics drivers and BIOS are updated to the latest version!

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.0.4 Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

- Fixed an issue where a cart would stuck into the ground.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Notes
notes.notes:
**Notice**
The Strange City Discord channel is now open. Please find the link on the right side of the store page.
If you continue to experience issues such as crashes or freezes after the game update, please report them in the Discord channel.
*Before contacting Discord, please ensure your graphics driver and BIOS are up to date!

Monsters
- Improved the grab detection for the Chapter 3 boss monster.
- Increased the movement range of the Chapter 2 doll monster.

Levels
- Improved the expression in certain levels for a smoother experience.
- Enhanced visibility in the tutorial level.
- Added checkpoints in some sections.

Player
- Improved smoothness of movement when move close by the walls.
- Adjusted interaction speed with certain objects for quicker response.
- Expanded the flashlight's brightness range.

Sound
- The 'Master Volume' is now divided into SFX and BGM for more detailed volume control.
- Refined some sound effects for a more natural feel.
- Adjusted the volume of certain background and sound effects.

ETC
- Improved gameplay flow by fixing an issue where pausing during some cutscenes would disrupt progress.
- Changed the brightness adjustment system for better usability.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Notes
notes.notes:
Localization
- Japanese translation added.
  日本語が追加されました。

Bosses
- A new attack motion added for the Chapter 2 boss.
- Adjusted animation transition logic for the Chapter 3 boss.
- Improved intuitiveness of the mechanic in the Chapter 5 boss room.

Levels
- Fixed an issue where errors occurred upon death in the Chapter 2 boss room.
- Updated the level design of the Chapter 3 boss room.
- Fixed some disconnected points in Chapter 4 levels.
- Resolved an issue where the elevator lever in Chapter 4 occasionally failed to operate and fixed the issue where players could climb the elevator walls.
- Updated the level design of the Chapter 4 boss room.

Player
- Fixed areas where the climbing animation didn't work.
- Resolved an issue where pushable/pullable objects would get stuck against walls and become immovable.

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Hot Fix Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the minecart buried in the ground.
- Fixed an issue where the button colors wouldn’t revert to their original state if the button pressing order was incorrect.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0 Hot Fix Notes
notes.notes:
We have discovered the following anomalies in The Strange City.
Our dispatched agents have resolved these issues, and the report is as follows.

Level
- Fixed certain terrain issues that restricted player movement.
- Improved visibility in specific areas.

Player
- Improved the interaction mechanics with ladders.
- Resolved an issue where the game occasionally froze during object interactions.
- Fixed a bug where interactions with certain objects were not functioning as intended.

Monsters
- Improved animation quality for certain monsters.
- Adjusted monster paths to eliminate awkward movement patterns.
- Fixed a bug where movement and attack speed changes based on monster patterns were not applied correctly.

There will be improvements to the balance and details of the Boss Stage in the next patch update.

B.A.R.D
